summary: Fix plugs the httpx bot-token leak with defence-in-depth: (1) httpx/httpcore/urllib3/requests loggers bumped to WARNING, (2) root + per-noisy-logger token-redacting filter with regex r'\d{6,12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}'. Regex correctly matches BotFather-issued tokens (bot_id:secret shape, 8-10 digits + 35-char suffix), and bounded by URL delimiter '/' in practice so it stops at token boundary. Root-filter attachment means any un-audited third-party library that propagates to root is also scrubbed.

low.title: curl_cffi not in the muted logger list
low.detail: requirements.txt lists curl_cffi==0.15.0. It is used by autoevolution/lamley scraping (non-Telegram URLs) and is unlikely to ever see a bot token, but defence-in-depth would add 'curl_cffi' to the level-bump loop to avoid surprise INFO lines in future code paths.
low.recommendation: Optional: extend the _noisy tuple with 'curl_cffi'. Not required — source-scraping URLs contain no secrets.

low.title: Regex unanchored — theoretical over-match on long digit+':'+alnum substrings
low.detail: The pattern is unanchored and greedy; a log line containing e.g. a long UUID preceded by a digit run and a colon could be partially redacted. Not a security concern (redaction bias is safer than leak bias), and real-world collision rate is negligible.
low.recommendation: Accept as-is. If noise becomes an issue, tighten to a word-boundary or URL-path-boundary variant.

info.title: sanitize_error_message still complements this layer
info.detail: The existing sanitize_error_message in news_bot.py scrubs env-var VALUES from exception strings before they reach admin messages / DB last_error columns. The new filter scrubs token-SHAPED substrings from LogRecords. The two layers are orthogonal and both remain necessary.

info.title: Token rotation required out-of-band
info.detail: Code fix does not address historical leak — every prior run at INFO level wrote the live token to stdout/journal. Operator MUST rotate TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN via @BotFather and update .env before the next deploy. This is explicitly called out in decisions.md.

remaining_exposure_paths: None material. curl_cffi has its own logger but handles non-Telegram URLs; if ever used against api.telegram.org the root filter still catches the token shape.
